text: Machine learning is a type of technology that helps computers learn from information without being directly programmed. One common method is supervised learning, where a computer is given training data with correct answers. The computer uses this data to build models, which are like rules it creates by itself. After learning, the computer can make predictions about new information it has never seen before. The quality of these predictions is called accuracy, and it shows how well the model has learned. Better training data usually leads to more accurate predictions. Machine learning is now used in many everyday things, such as recommending videos or recognising faces in photos.
